from solution import overlapping


def test_issue_example_disjoint_is_false():
    """Example overlapping([1,2,3,4,5],[6,7,8,9]) == False."""
    # intersection size 0 == 0 => False
    assert overlapping([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], [6, 7, 8, 9]) == False


def test_issue_shared_middle_value_is_true():
    """Overlapping sequences sharing a value return True."""
    # intersection {3} size 1 > 0 => True
    assert overlapping([1, 2, 3], [3, 4, 5]) == True


def test_issue_shared_first_value_is_true():
    """Overlapping at the first position still counts as overlapping."""
    # intersection {1} size 1 > 0 => True
    assert overlapping([1, 2, 3], [1, 5, 6]) == True


def test_issue_shared_last_value_is_true():
    """Overlapping at the last position still counts as overlapping."""
    # intersection {9} size 1 > 0 => True
    assert overlapping([1, 2, 9], [7, 8, 9]) == True


def test_issue_singleton_match_is_true():
    """Single-element sequences with the same value overlap."""
    # intersection {42} size 1 > 0 => True
    assert overlapping([42], [42]) == True


def test_issue_singleton_mismatch_is_false():
    """Single-element sequences with different values do not overlap."""
    # intersection size 0 == 0 => False
    assert overlapping([42], [43]) == False


def test_issue_empty_first_is_false():
    """An empty first sequence cannot overlap with any sequence."""
    # intersection size 0 == 0 => False
    assert overlapping([], [1, 2, 3]) == False


def test_issue_empty_second_is_false():
    """An empty second sequence cannot overlap with any sequence."""
    # intersection size 0 == 0 => False
    assert overlapping([1, 2, 3], []) == False


def test_issue_both_empty_is_false():
    """Two empty sequences do not overlap."""
    # intersection size 0 == 0 => False
    assert overlapping([], []) == False


def test_issue_identical_lists_are_true():
    """Identical non-empty sequences overlap."""
    # intersection {1, 2} size 2 > 0 => True
    assert overlapping([1, 2], [1, 2]) == True


def test_contract_inputs_are_not_modified():
    """Overlapping check must not modify its input sequences."""
    a = [1, 2, 3]
    b = [4, 5, 6]
    overlapping(a, b)
    # 3 elements kept + 3 elements kept = 6 total => unchanged
    assert a == [1, 2, 3] and b == [4, 5, 6]


def test_contract_order_does_not_matter():
    """Overlapping check is symmetric in its two sequences."""
    # intersection {2} size 1 > 0 in both orders => equal
    assert overlapping([1, 2, 3], [2, 4, 5]) == overlapping([2, 4, 5], [1, 2, 3])
